name: West Orange
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in West Orange, NJ 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in West Orange, NJ for 2026: Turtle Back Zoo Holiday Lights, Santa visits and the downtown Holiday Open House.
lede: West Orange is home to the free Holiday Lights at Essex County's Turtle Back Zoo, and downtown adds a Holiday Open House with free Santa photos and a tree lighting at Town Hall.
celebrates: The Essex County Turtle Back Zoo anchors West Orange's Christmas season with Holiday Lights, which its site describes as a winter stroll under the sparkling lights of over 50 winter and animal characters, free with donation. Santa meet and greets, a princess sing along and a Grinch weekend fill the zoo's December calendar. In town, the Downtown West Orange Alliance holds its annual Holiday Open House with a character breakfast, free photos with Santa and a gingerbread house activity, paired with the annual tree lighting at Town Hall. Verona's Fair in the Square is held the same day nearby.
lastyear: West Orange's own township calendar shows how last year went: the 2025 Holiday Open House and Tree Lighting was on Saturday, December 6, from 9 am to 6 pm at Washington Elementary School and Town Hall. It listed a breakfast with holiday characters, free photos with Santa courtesy of Benji's Mexican Grill, guided trolley tours of the historic downtown, a stuffed animal workshop and make your own gingerbread house, and the Mayor's tree lighting at Town Hall at 4 pm with a petting zoo and live performances.
facts: Turtle Back Zoo's Holiday Lights schedule is posted on the zoo's own site, with Santa photos in the Gazebo, ice carving demonstrations and appearances by princesses and superheroes through the season. The Downtown West Orange Alliance's page asks families to register for some Holiday Open House activities, and the 2025 township listing sent families to an online registration page. West Orange Town Hall is at 66 Main Street.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in West Orange itself. Our New Jersey guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-new-jersey lists the Christmas train rides across the state, and the Whippany Railway Museum's Polar Express is carded on our Morristown page. Families who want a train day often pair a zoo night with a ride elsewhere in North Jersey.

faq: What are the best Christmas events for kids in West Orange, NJ?

Holiday Lights at Turtle Back Zoo is free with a donation and runs through the season. The Downtown West Orange Holiday Open House has a character breakfast, free Santa photos and a tree lighting at Town Hall.
Is Turtle Back Zoo Holiday Lights free?
Turtle Back Zoo's site says the Holiday Lights are free with donation. It encourages guests to bring nonperishable food, new unwrapped toys or winter coats.
Where can kids meet Santa in West Orange?
Santa meets families in the Gazebo at Turtle Back Zoo and at the Downtown West Orange Holiday Open House, where photos with Santa are free.
Does West Orange have its own Christmas Eve services page?
Not yet. We checked and there is no West Orange page for Christmas Eve services.
